Welcome to the Vancouver dbt Meetup 👋

dbt Meetups are networking events open to everyone working with data! Talks typically focus on community members’ experiences with dbt. You may also hear presentations on broader topics such as analytics engineering, modern data stacks, AI, data operations, modeling, testing, and team structures.

To attend this event, please review and agree to the Health and Safety Policy and Terms of Participation: https://www.getdbt.com/legal/health-and-safety-policy

⚠️ Our venue has limited capacity, so please only RSVP if you plan to attend. If your plans change, update your RSVP to “Not Going” as soon as possible. Message the organizer if you need assistance.

Agenda

6:00 > Arrive, Eat, Drink
6:30 > Speaker 1
7:00 > Speaker 2
7:30 > Socialize

1st Speaker:

Daniel Goldberd, Mercury
Talk: "Your Title Isn't Your Job Anymore", about how data roles are converging into a single full-stack function, and why analytics engineering is turning into a skill everyone on the data team uses rather than a job title

2nd Speaker:

Kyle Cheung, Greybeam
Talk: "Running DuckDB and Snowflake in Production", about saving costs with DuckDB while running the dbt project in Snowflake

Venue

📍We are going to meet in the heart of Vancouver downtown, thanks to our host Clarity. Just meet at the entrance and someone will be there to escort you in for check-in.

🏠 Address: 980 Howe st, Vancouver, BC

Reach out if you're interested in volunteering/speaking!

➡️ Join the dbt Slack community: https://www.getdbt.com/community/

For the best Meetup experience, make sure to join the #local-vancouver channel in dbt Slack (https://slack.getdbt.com/).

dbt is the standard in data transformation, used by over 40,000 organizations worldwide. Through the application of software engineering best practices like modularity, version control, testing, and documentation, dbt’s analytics engineering workflow helps teams work more efficiently to produce data the entire organization can trust.

Learn more: https://www.getdbt.com/

REGISTER HERE 👉 https://www.getdbt.com/resources/webinars/community-slack-ama

🚀 Hey Community! Are you ready to dive deep, get insights, and satisfy your curiosity?

We’re hosting monthly live Ask Me Anything events! It's the perfect platform to quench your curiosity and get to know each other better. Don't miss out on this opportunity to connect and learn together.

What to Expect:

Discussing trends in the analytics space
Sharing key takeaways from the recent events
Hearing your questions and thoughts

Speaker: Erica Louie, Data @ dbt Labs
Host: Bolaji Oyejide, Digital Community Mgr @ dbt Labs
Topic: Careers in data, building a data team, the dbt Semantic Layer, and scaling your dbt project
When: November 21st @ 2pm EST
Where: Virtual and in #dbt-community-merge

Erica was the second employee at dbt Labs, then called Fishtown Analytics and she's seen dbt grow, a lot. In this AMA, Erica will share more on her career in data, her strong opinions on building a data team, how she manages her team, the dbt Semantic Layer, scaling your dbt project, and more on her Substack.

Register now to get the link to watch and join the #dbt-community-ama channel in Slack to participate live!

Read more
Speaker
Erica Louie, dbt Labs

Second hire at dbt Labs, former Head of Data, and now leading the product data team (and previously worked for BuzzFeed's data team), Erica "ric" Louie proudly hails from a liberal arts background (studied political science + italian) and grew her career in data at dbt Labs starting from the ground-up. She firmly believes that anyone can be a data practitioner with the right mentors, resources (sans trivial data jargon), and a good sense of humor. While rethinking the philosophy behind data systems, operations, and teams is one of her favorite topics, she enjoys thinking and writing about the human experience, and how it intersects with the work we choose to do and who we choose to do it with.

dbt Meetups are networking events open to all folks working with data! Talks predominantly focus on community members' experience with dbt; however, you'll catch presentations on broader topics such as analytics engineering, data stacks, data ops, modeling, testing, and team structures.

🏠Venue Host: Talk Shop Media - 1498 West 5th Ave, Vancouver
🤝Organizer: Reinaldo Calcaño & Milan Mosny with Infostrux

To attend, please read the Required Participation Language for In-Person Events with dbt Labs: https://bit.ly/3QIJXFb

The doors open at 5:30 pm. Presentations begin at 6:05pm. Food and refreshments will be provided.

Our venue has capacity limits, so please only RSVP if you intend to come and and reach out to reinaldo@infostrux.com or DM in dbt Slack if you need to cancel last minute or change your RSVP status on the Meetup to "Not Going."

➡️ Join the dbt Slack community: https://www.getdbt.com/community/
🤝For the best Meetup experience, make sure to join the #local-\ channel in dbt Slack (https://slack.getdbt.com/).

📝Agenda

5:30 - 6:00 | Check in/Registration (30 min)
6:00 - 6:05 | Welcome Remarks by Meetup Host (5 min)
6:05 - 6:30 | Presentation 1 Milan Mosny (CTO - Infostrux) - Intro to dbt and dbt best practices (30 min)
6:35 - 6:50 | Presentation 1 Q&A (15 min)
7:00 - 7:30 | Presentation 2 Matt Helm (Member of Technical Staff at Materialize) Building Dimensional Models with dbt: What works well and where there's room for improvement (30 min)
7:30 - 7:45 | Presentation 2 Q&A (15 min)
7:45 - 7:50 | Closing Remarks by Meetup Host (5 min)
7:50 - 8:00 | Call for speakers for next time and raise your hand if you are hiring and please state the company and role briefly

---------------------------------
dbt is a data transformation framework that lets analysts and engineers collaborate using their shared knowledge of SQL. Through the application of software engineering best practices like modularity, version control, testing, and documentation, dbt’s analytics engineering workflow helps teams work more efficiently to produce data the entire organization can trust.
Learn more: https://www.getdbt.com/

Infostrux is an Elite Snowflake Partner offering next-generation consulting services for the Snowflake Data Cloud. Our Data experts help organizations migrate and implement Snowflake. We are a one-stop shop, providing comprehensive professional and managed services for your data needs.
Learn more: https://www.infostrux.com/

Talk Shop is a full-service integrated communications agency with expertise in public relations, social media, digital marketing, influencer relations, branding and creative execution. We create ideas that inspire while driven by goals that produce results.

Milan Mosny has a vast experience in data engineering, data analytics, business intelligence, machine learning, computational color vision, and natural language processing. He is currently the Chief Technology Officer at Infostrux solutions.
